description: FAULTLINE v5 card paintings (new colorless cards, curses and the Architect, Warden and Ghost keeper sets). Same local Krea 2 recipe as the v3 cards: original Switch crop as style reference at 0.8, resolution-dependent shift. Keeper sets carry a faint keeper accent (Architect teal-cyan, Warden warm amber, Ghost pale violet-teal); curses lean colder. Two candidates per card, the chosen seed is 'seed'; generate with scripts/generate_card_art.py --manifest docs/art-v5-manifest.json --only <id> --seed <n>, export with --webp.

cards.prompt: A dark atmospheric science-fantasy collectible-card painting, matching the painted look of the reference. A small brass dish antenna on a slender chipped ivory mast stands on a broken cathedral ledge.
